_comment: DeadPoly egg v2.0.0. Maintainer: Azzy-tm. Windows dedicated server under Wine on a Linux node. Nested executable, player connection, startup detection, and filtered log forwarding verified on maintainer setup; external connectivity and long-term save persistence still require regression testing.
name: DeadPoly
author: 34712670+Azzy-tm@users.noreply.github.com
description: v2.0.0. Installs Windows Steam app 2208380 and launches DeadPoly/Binaries/Win64/DeadPolyServer.exe through Wine on a Linux Pterodactyl node. Optional updates on startup. Requires at least 2 CPU cores and 6 GB RAM; 4 cores are recommended for larger player counts. Gameplay and access lists configured manually. No API key, background update monitor, or mod loader required.
startup:
bash -c 'set -eo pipefail
cd /home/container
export HOME=/home/container
export WINEPREFIX="${WINEPREFIX:-/home/container/.wine}"
export WINEDEBUG=-all,+debugstr
mkdir -p "$HOME/Steam/logs"
if [ "${DEADPOLY_AUTO_UPDATE,,}" = true ]; then
    STEAMCMD=/home/container/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh
    [ -x "$STEAMCMD" ] || { echo '[startup] SteamCMD is missing. Reinstall the server after backing up.'; exit 1; }
    "$STEAMCMD" +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update 2208380 validate +quit
fi
EXE=./DeadPoly/Binaries/Win64/DeadPolyServer.exe
[ -f "$EXE" ] || { echo '[startup] Nested DeadPoly server executable is missing.'; exit 1; }
[[ "$SERVER_PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo '[startup] Invalid SERVER_PORT'; exit 1; }
[[ "$QUERY_PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo '[startup] Invalid QUERY_PORT'; exit 1; }
EXTRA=()
if [ -n "${EXTRA_ARGS:-}" ]; then read -r -a EXTRA <<< "$EXTRA_ARGS"; fi
LOG=/home/container/DeadPoly/Saved/Logs/DeadPoly.log
rm -f "$LOG"
echo '[startup] DeadPoly egg v2.0.0: launching nested server with filtered log forwarding.'
wine "$EXE" -log -stdout -FullStdOutLogOutput -unattended "-port=$SERVER_PORT" "-queryport=$QUERY_PORT" "${EXTRA[@]}" > /home/container/wine-output.log 2>&1 &
WINE_PID=$!
tail -F "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | grep --line-buffered -E "Successfully created session|Error:|LogNet .*listening on port|LogWorld Bringing World" &
TAIL_PID=$!
wait "$WINE_PID"
kill "$TAIL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
'

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# DeadPoly Pterodactyl egg v2.0.0
set -eo pipefail
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steamcmd
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
mkdir -p "$HOME/Steam/logs"
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1 tar
if [ ! -x /mnt/server/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz -o /tmp/deadpoly-steamcmd.tar.gz
    tar -xzf /tmp/deadpoly-steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/.steamcmd
    rm -f /tmp/deadpoly-steamcmd.tar.gz
fi
/mnt/server/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 2208380 validate +quit
[ -f DeadPoly/Binaries/Win64/DeadPolyServer.exe ] || { echo '[install] Required nested executable is missing.'; exit 1; }
# Stage only files that do not already exist; never overwrite configuration.
if [ -d 'DeadPoly/Saved/1 RENAME Config' ]; then
    mkdir -p DeadPoly/Saved/Config
    cp -an 'DeadPoly/Saved/1 RENAME Config/.' DeadPoly/Saved/Config/
fi
echo 'DeadPoly v2.0.0 installation complete. Review the shipped configuration before starting.'

variables.name: Container Built-in Updater
variables.description: Keep at 0. The separate DEADPOLY_AUTO_UPDATE variable controls the Windows-specific updater. Existing servers must set this saved value to 0.

variables.name: DeadPoly Automatic Updates
variables.description: Update and validate the Windows server files before each start. Accepts true or false in either listed case.

variables.name: Query Port (Unverified)
variables.description: Compatibility launch argument only. No listener was observed on 7778 in the tested setup. No secondary allocation or forwarding is required solely because this variable exists.

variables.name: Extra Arguments
variables.description: Optional whitespace-separated arguments. Quoted multiword arguments and shell expressions are not evaluated. Leave empty initially.
